generation.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: WorldSim concept-05 ancient settlement item sprite, one isolated game asset, intended for a final 64x64 transparent tile.
Input images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: first is the adopted item contact sheet, second is the concept-05 ink-and-tone props. Do not reproduce a sheet, labels, landscape, scenery or backgrounds.
Style: hand-drawn warm brown-black ink contour with restrained translucent pigment wash, natural-history game illustration. Main/secondary line width ratio 2:1. Sparse lower-left to upper-right parallel hatching only on shadow faces: metal 2-3 edge accents and 1-2 hatch groups, ore 3-5 facet seams and 2 hatch groups, wood 3-5 grain lines. No all-over stippling or tiny white speckles.
Palette: quiet earth tones; iron dark neutral grey, wood ochre/umber; warm ink. No specular glare, chrome, neon, pixel art, vector icon, 3D rendering or photorealism.
Projection: front three-quarter, about 20 degrees down, soft upper-left light, naturally resting object with narrow top face. Low wide silhouette, roughly twice as wide as high where object anatomy allows; all parts fully visible, centred, generous transparent margin.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha, no ground plane, no cast shadow, no halo, no glow, no backdrop or paper texture outside object. Absolutely no text, numbers, grid, border, watermark, labels or other objects.
Preserve one coherent illustrated material language matching references. Keep the design simple enough to read at 32px.
Subject: One proposed small ancient round wooden shield resting on its rim, viewed in the same front three-quarter item projection. Four simple ochre-brown wooden planks, one small dark-grey iron central boss and narrow dark-grey iron rim. Plain undecorated practical shield, no heraldry, no spikes, no person, no straps extending outside its silhouette.
